Brand: logo and colors

Source: R/brand.R
kit_brand.Rd

kitDesign looks like KIT by default. When another project or lab uses kitDesign, kit_brand() swaps the logo and colors; typeface, borders, shadows, and how components look follow the design language and stay the same. With no arguments it is KIT (kit_brand()), and pages look exactly as before.

Usage

kit_brand(
  name = "KIT",
  logo = NULL,
  mark = NULL,
  logo_alt = NULL,
  colors = list()
)

Arguments

name

The brand name, e.g. "KIT", "示範實驗室" ("Demo Lab").

logo

Path to the header logo file (SVG or PNG); for NULL see above; FALSE shows no logo.

mark

Path to the browser tab icon file (SVG or PNG, square); when NULL, logo is used.

logo_alt

Alt text for the logo; when NULL, "KIT 標誌" ("KIT logo") for KIT, or " 標誌" (" logo").

colors

Colors to replace: a named list or named character vector; names are in the table above, values are "#RRGGBB" or color names R knows. An unknown name stops with an error listing the names you can use.

Value

A kit_brand object (a list: name, logo_alt, colors (11 #rrggbb values), and the logo files).

Details

Pass the brand to kit_page() (brand =), or set it once when the app starts: options(kitDesign.brand = kit_brand(...)). After that kit_page(), kit_header(), kit_theme(), kit_colors(), kit_chart_sequential(), and kit_plotly_style() all use it (kit_current_brand()).

Colors (colors) use the design-language names; anything not given follows KIT:

NameCSS variableKITUsed for
ink--nb-ink#141414text, borders, shadows
page--nb-page#faf7f0page background
card--nb-card#ffffffcards, inputs, tables
accent--nb-lime#c6d033main color block: header, primary button, current tab
accent_light--nb-bg-new#e8f0a0light main color: new columns in diagrams, light end of the color scale
primary--nb-green#006835links, checkboxes, progress bars, dark end of the color scale
primary_hover--nb-green-hover#004d27link hover
success--nb-mint#b9f0a8【完成】 (done)
warning--nb-yellow#ffde59【完成，但請注意】 (done, but take note)
danger--nb-salmon#ff9b8f【停下來】 (stopped), danger button
info--nb-sky#a8dcffinfo callout

If only accent is given, accent_light is derived from it (mixed with white); if only primary is given, primary_hover is derived from it (darkened). Text on color blocks is always ink: when choosing accent and the four status colors, check that ink on them has at least 4.5:1 contrast; primary is a text color and also needs 4.5:1 on page.

Logo: logo is the full header logo, mark is the small browser tab icon (square; when not given, logo is used). Both are paths to SVG or PNG files; the files are read when the brand is created, so changing the working directory later does not matter. In Shiny they are served by an htmlDependency containing only these two files (the folder they live in is not exposed); with kit_header(logo = "inline") they are written as a data URI. With name = "KIT" and no logo, the KIT logo is used; with any other name and no logo, the header has no logo. logo = FALSE never shows a logo.

See also

kit_current_brand(), kit_page(), kit_theme(), kit_chart_sequential()

Examples

kit_brand()
#> <kit_brand> KIT
#>   logo: kit-logo.svg (kitDesign)  (alt: KIT 標誌)
#>   mark: kit-mark.svg (kitDesign), kit-mark-64.png (kitDesign)
#>   colors (* = not KIT):
#>     ink            #141414
#>     page           #faf7f0
#>     card           #ffffff
#>     accent         #c6d033
#>     accent_light   #e8f0a0
#>     primary        #006835
#>     primary_hover  #004d27
#>     success        #b9f0a8
#>     warning        #ffde59
#>     danger         #ff9b8f
#>     info           #a8dcff

# Another lab: blue colors, its own logo
demo <- kit_brand(
  "示範實驗室",
  logo = system.file("examples", "brand", "demo-logo.svg", package = "kitDesign"),
  mark = system.file("examples", "brand", "demo-mark.svg", package = "kitDesign"),
  colors = list(accent = "#9cc0ff", primary = "#1f4fa3", page = "#f5f7fa")
)
demo
#> <kit_brand> 示範實驗室
#>   logo: demo-logo.svg  (alt: 示範實驗室 標誌)
#>   mark: demo-mark.svg
#>   colors (* = not KIT):
#>     ink            #141414
#>     page           #f5f7fa  *
#>     card           #ffffff
#>     accent         #9cc0ff  *
#>     accent_light   #d4e2ff  *
#>     primary        #1f4fa3  *
#>     primary_hover  #1f3b77  *
#>     success        #b9f0a8
#>     warning        #ffde59
#>     danger         #ff9b8f
#>     info           #a8dcff
if (interactive()) {
  options(kitDesign.brand = demo)   # use this brand for the whole app
  kit_gallery()
}
